name.value: Seymour River Fish Hatchery & Education Centre

description.value: The Seymour River Fish Hatchery & Education Centre is operated by the non-profit Seymour Salmonid Society and raises hundreds of thousands of coho, steelhead, chum, and pink salmon annually to supplement fish stocks cut off from spawning grounds by Seymour Falls Dam. The society runs a well-regarded 'Gently Down the Seymour' education program serving 1,200–1,500 school children per year and hosts public events such as Family Fishing Day. Access to the hatchery site is gate-controlled and the road is explicitly stated to be not open to the general public.

address.value: PO Box 30085, North Vancouver, BC V7H 2Y8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a working salmon hatchery and education centre run by the Seymour Salmonid Society; the road to the hatchery is explicitly stated to be not open to the public (gate-controlled access via Rice Lake Gatehouse, restricted to volunteers). No cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Seymour Fish Hatchery' differs from the website name 'Seymour River Fish Hatchery & Education Centre'; phone and website URL are confirmed via the website contact section.
